messages:
Mira: PSA: someone left a laptop on the bench with no name. Is this a new art installation or someone's panic? :eyes:
Ben: oh no. I saw it earlier, thought it was a communal whiteboard laptop. sorry.
Tao: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/laptop-mishap -> found it dramatic
Jules: can we start a 'label your gear' sticker rack? 2-for-1 on stickers = immediate compliance.
Mira: also if it's yours, ping here with laptop model and last app open so we can return it quickly.
Ben: it's a 13" matte thing w/ a cat sticker. @itsmine? (jk) :cat:
KitchenBot: Reminder: Lost & Found box is under the sink cabinet. Unclaimed electronics will be placed there at EOD.
PollBot: Quick community poll: 'Sticker rack: yay or nay?' react :thumbsup: for yay, :thumbsdown: for nay. Poll ends in 3 hours.
Tao: added :thumbsup:. stickers for order and peace.
Jules: If it's unclaimed by 5pm, I'll put it in the box and post a photo. no shame policy.
Ben: I put a sticky note on the laptop with my Slack handle in case owner checks in.
Mira: update: owner found! @Lina says it rolled off her bag this morning. Crisis averted. :relieved:
Lina: thanks team. will bring commuter stickers for everyone Friday as apology treats. :coffee:
Mira: stickers + coffee = solved. meeting adjourned.
